quality_check.description: A single vertical paper-cut still life framed by the recurring layered cream-paper card. The honey-lit foreground is dominated by recognizable calorie-dense foods including stacked burgers, fries, chocolate cake, and cookies, while smaller grapes, a salad bowl, and an apple sit farther back against subdued slate-blue paper layers. A slim red-skinned hand enters from the right in a muted red-and-charcoal plaid sleeve and reaches toward a burger. Orchard greens, muted amber, slate tones, fibrous-looking cut-paper shapes, shallow stacked depth, and soft diffused lighting visibly carry over from the continuity references.
violations: The requested low-angle viewpoint is weak; the tabletop arrangement reads closer to a frontal or mildly elevated presentation than a distinctly low-angle still life.

The reaching hand is generally simple and recognizable, but the fingers are somewhat elongated and the wrist-to-hand transition is slightly awkward.
